mapper.select: select t.*,ts.REALNAME,ts.USERNAME from TBL_ASSESS_STAFF t inner join TBL_STAFF ts on t.STAFFID=ts.STAFFID where t.ASSMARKID=#{assmarkid} order by t.STAFFID

select lin.*, ts.REALNAME,ts.USERNAME,T.ORGNAME from ( select * from TBL_ASSESS_MARK o where o.assmarkid in (select max(t.assmarkid) from TBL_ASSESS_MARK t where t.ASSID = #{assId} group by assorgid)) lin inner join TBL_ORGANIZATION T on lin.ASSORGID=T.ORGID inner join TBL_ASSESS TA on TA.ASSID=lin.ASSID inner join TBL_STAFF TS on TS.STAFFID=TA.LEADERID

SELECT DISTINCT ASS.ASSESSID,ASS.ASSESSNAME,ST.REALNAME,(CASE when STA.STATUS =1 then 0 else STA.STATUS END) status from tbl_assess ass LEFT JOIN TBL_ASSESS_MARK mar on ASS.ASSID=MAR.ASSID LEFT JOIN TBL_ASSESS_STAFF sta on MAR.ASSMARKID=STA.ASSMARKID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF st on STA.STAFFID=ST.STAFFID where ASS.ASSID=#{assid} and STA.ORGID= #{orgid} ORDER BY ASS.ASSESSID
